plans.name: Operating AI infrastructure networks
problem_set: Meeting bandwidth, density and power-efficiency pressure from AI scale inside the data center
Running reconfigurable optical switching and optical links at rack and cluster scale
Keeping optical transceivers and switching reliable while reducing power
plans.value_prop: The founder’s programmable nanophotonic processor research could inform experiments with reconfigurable optical switching.

plans.name: Designing and packaging photonic chips
problem_set: Co-packaging optics with processors and accelerators for AI systems
Building optical I/O chiplets and optical modules
plans.value_prop: The founder’s phase-shifter measurements could help chip designers evaluate optical loss and device spacing when integrating photonic components.

plans.name: Engineering quantum photonic hardware
problem_set: Designing and simulating photonic circuits for quantum hardware
Validating photonics hardware and packaging optical components
plans.value_prop: The founder’s programmable nanophotonic circuits could provide a reference design for testing optical transformations in quantum hardware.

plans.name: Laboratory research on photonic computing
problem_set: Scaling photonic computing approaches such as Ising machines to very large problem sizes
Testing whether photonic hardware can run neural-network-style workloads
plans.value_prop: The founder’s on-chip deep-learning experiments could give photonic computing labs a reference point for testing other workloads.
